evidence.evidence_text: To enhance knowledge transfer and enable zero-shot generalization among various combinations, in this work we propose a novel unified framework, called UNIEVENT.

Inspired by prefix-based multitask learning, our approach organizes event relational reasoning tasks into a coordinate system with multiple axes, representing inter-event relations and reasoning formulations.
We then train a unified text-to-text generative model that utilizes coordinate-assigning prefixes for each task.
